svg.title: garmin-papi-mcp flow
svg.desc: Your Personal API key goes from your browser to the server only; the server checks it with Garmin and seals it into a token the AI client holds; on each tool call the server unseals the token, exchanges the key for a cached Garmin JWT and reads your data.
svg.text: straight to the server, never via the AI
Token sealed with the server's key
